zh: 浪花和泡沫混成的波紋
島嶼羅列， 波痕粼粼
藍天單純有如心事透明
en: Vancouver's skyline
Gradually vanishing into the vast twilight haze
The sea's surface calm
The Dawn Princess sails further and further on
Trailing behind a single beam
Ripples mingled of spray and foam
Winding through the hazy thin mist
The evening wind gently blows
Wherever I gaze, all is past dust and bygone affairs
Threading through the Inside Passage
Islands arrayed in rows, ripple-marks shimmering
Five hundred miles of waterway
Winding forward with the crystalline summer
The sea breeze gentle as a song
The blue sky, simple, as though one's thoughts were transparent
Just like this
Alaska, across tens of millions of years
A scene finely carved and polished
Scene after scene unfolds before my eyes
A picturesque andante
Section by section, left for others to cut and splice

zh: 或以平波靜水， 岬灣倒影
抖落欲說還休等待詮釋的晃動心情
或以蓊鬰蒼翠，水鳥低翔
提醒物種品類共生共存的和諧安祥
或以長空白雲， 漁舟數點
啟示萬物逆旅百代過客的自然遞變
或以冰河長流， 雪峰連嶂
觸發沉澱已久早於或忘的高思遠望
或以蒼海孤帆， 晚霞滿天
牽引綿綿鄉情親情友情的因缘懷念
en: Or with calm waves and still water, capes and bays reflected
Shaking off a wavering mood, words held back, waiting to be understood
Or with lush, deep green, water birds skimming low
A reminder of the peaceful harmony where species coexist
Or with wide sky and white clouds, a few fishing boats scattered
Revealing the natural succession by which all things are travelers, and a hundred generations mere passing guests
Or with glaciers flowing long, snowy peaks in ranges
Stirring lofty thoughts and distant visions long settled or forgotten
Or with a lone sail on a vast sea, evening glow filling the sky
Drawing out the endless remembered bonds of home, family, and friendship

zh: 離岸浮冰， 隔水雲煙
鮭魚迴遊， 鯨類偶現
峻巖幽谷， 懸泉流水
神話圖騰， 小城悠閒
en: As for
Floating ice off the shore, mist and cloud across the water
Salmon return upstream, whales occasionally appear
Towering crags, secluded valleys, hanging springs and flowing water
Mythic totems, the small town at ease
There are also those several times
An unspoken freedom
All follows the sea wind
Merging into the poem
Merging into the passing years
Merging into a realm still waiting to be crossed

points.zh: Inside Passage (内灣航道) 是北美洲北部太平洋沿岸的天然網狀水道，從西雅圖北上，經加拿大溫哥華島到阿拉斯加的Skagway，水道全長1600公里 (1000英哩)。在阿拉斯加境内長800公里 (  500英哩  )，有1000多個島嶼羅列其中，和無數的海灣和岬角。内灣航道狹長，有大島和群島作屏障，抵擋太平洋的惡劣風暴，且水道深邃平穩，沿岸景色蒼翠壯麗，雪峰連綿，時有冰河點綴，鲸類浮現，是遊輪旅遊的勝選。沿途除了有北半球最高緯度的雨林，東加斯國家森林 (Tongass National Forest) 外，還有下列港口和勝景：
Ketchikan： 阿拉斯加最南端的城鎮，有 「世界鲑魚之都」的美稱。印第安圖騰中心和鮭魚逆溯等景勝。
Juneau：風光明媚的朱諾，是阿拉斯加的州都。因街道起伏，商店林立，而有「小舊金山」的稱號。
Sitka：是十八世紀俄羅斯移民古鎭，保存着俄國式的人文遺風。有北美最古老的東正教堂St. Michael's Cathedral。
Skagway：是1898年阿拉斯加淘金熱時期，最繁榮的淘金古鎮，可乘白色關口山路火車 (White Pass & Yukon Route Railway)，沿秀麗峻峭山景一路到美加邊界，引發當年淘金的思古幽情。
Seward：位於Anchorage南方200公里的不凍港，是遊輪旅遊最北端的集散港口。因記念1866年購買阿拉斯加的國務卿William Henry Seward (1801-1872) 而命名。
Glacier Bay：冰河灣國家公園佔地廣大，由蜿蜒160公里的大冰原注入冰河灣。遊客有機會在遊輪甲板上，觀看冰河冰塊崩塌落海的奇景，及其引發的風雷動的巨響，感受懾人心魄的磅礴氣勢。

College Fjord：學院峽灣位於威廉王子灣(Prince William Sound)的北端，由十六條冰河組成，壯麗雄偉。在學院峽灣可同時看到八條冰河，是觀賞冰河崩落和海豹悠遊的景點。1964年美國史上最強烈的地震「Good Friday Earthquake」，其震央就在此峽灣。College Fjord 的名稱，是缘由於1899年由Harvard and Amherst 大學二位教授發現而命名。
